title: Cerebral palsy
summary: Cerebral palsy with disorganization of motor function in two extremities, OR significant interference with communication, OR significant emotional/behavioral disorder.

children.criterion: Cerebral palsy diagnosis (typically present from infancy/childhood)
Motor disorganization OR communication interference OR emotional/behavioral disorder
Disorganization of motor function in two extremities resulting in extreme limitation in standing, balancing, or use of upper extremities
Significant interference in communication due to speech, hearing, or visual deficit
Significant emotional disturbance or significant intellectual disability evidenced by marked limitation in mental functioning
